literal_meaning: চটানোর শব্দের দ্বিত্ব (onomatopoeic reduplication suggesting a sticky or adhering sound/feel)
figurative_meaning_en: A reduplicated word indicating stickiness or adhesiveness
example_sentences_in_bangla: হাতে আঠা লাগিয়ে চটচট করে উঠল।
example_sentences_in_english: The glue made my hands sticky.
note: This is primarily an onomatopoeic expression used in colloquial Bengali to describe a sticky sensation or sound.
